title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S04 E01 — Epic Fails
A miracle cure with a deadly catch; A romantic gesture explodes in a president's face; A simple home repair spirals wildly out of control; Sometimes the biggest disasters begin with the best intentions.

title: Mysteries From Above
description:
S05 E01 — Unexpected Naturally
Head to the Australian outback for a peek at some beehive-shaped and cone-shaped structures; spot a neon green pool of water in Huelva, Spain; odd geometric shapes near Latvia's Gulf of Riga and a forest anomaly in Hawaii.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E20 — Most Shocking Dances With Death
What drives someone to gamble with their own life? From a French tailor who leaps off the Eiffel Tower to a man struck by lightning more times than should be humanly possible, these perilous wagers with death are as shocking as they are unbelievable.

title: The UnBelievable With Dan Aykroyd
description:
S03 E06 — Outlandish Ideas
From a coastal cleanup plan that ends with an earth-shaking surprise, to a fugitive's fiery fix for an unexpected problem, these are the real-life moments when people thought way outside the box.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E04 — Pearl Harbor
Japan escalates their war in China, drawing increasing U.S. sanctions and widespread outrage; driven by resource shortages and military ideology, Japan attacks Pearl Harbor in a move that reshapes the course of World War II.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E05 — The War at Sea
Examine how America's battle to control the seas against the German U-boats in the Atlantic and Japan's navy in the Pacific turns the tide of the war.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E06 — Guadalcanal
After the attack on Pearl Harbor, Japanese forces sweep across Southeast Asia; on Guadalcanal, United States Marines are given the bloody task of stopping their relentless advance.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E07 — Darkness Falls
As Hitler's reach extends beyond Germany and darkness descends on Europe, his hateful rhetoric leads to anti-Jewish persecution and ultimately, genocide.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E08 — Operation Torch
The first joint U.S.-British offensive of the war, thousands of inexperienced U.S. troops and their untested leader Eisenhower, face off against the hardened German Afrika Korps and the infamous Field Marshal Erwin Rommel.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E09 — Secrets and Lies
Behind the fierce frontline clashes of WWII, a hidden battle rages - one of espionage, deception, and codebreaking; in rural England, a group of brilliant academics work to crack Germany's unbreakable Enigma Code and change the course of the war.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E10 — Stalingrad
In Operation Blue, the German Army fights to take Soviet oil fields and the city of Stalingrad, becoming one of the deadliest battles ever fought and a major turning point on the Eastern Front.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E11 — Italy
The Allies hope to quickly penetrate the Nazi Reich via Italy but instead endure a months-long slog with devastating results.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E12 — Battle for the Skies
Allied air forces engage in a fierce and costly battle with the German Luftwaffe over the skies of Europe.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E13 — Overlord
The Allies undertake Operation Overlord, a complicated and massive military invasion, to liberate Occupied France and open a true second front in Western Europe.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E14 — Long Road to Tokyo
The Allies and Japan clash in the jungles and plains of Asia, the "forgotten theater" of World War II, as America struggles to bring the fight to Tokyo's door.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E15 — Home Front
As the tide begins to turn against the Axis powers, the leaders of Germany and Japan deploy opposite strategies on their home fronts.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E16 — Resistance
Resistance to Nazi occupation and oppression is a constant throughout the war, with results both triumphant and devastating.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E17 — No Surrender
The Pacific campaign reaches a brutal and bloody fever pitch from 1944 to 1945.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E18 — Last Days of the Reich
The war in Europe reaches a climax as Allied armies advance towards Berlin and Hitler orders his people to fight to the last man.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E19 — Endgame
The most terrible weapon ever created will change the course of the war in the Pacific.

title: World War II With Tom Hanks
description:
S01 E20 — Fall Out
The end of the second world war and the dawn of the nuclear age see its two great victors go from allies to adversaries.

title: American Pickers
description:

Bill's main street hardware store; the guys are invited to the Possum Trot, a down-home country auction; Ed's Georgia property features a missile on the lawn and building after building of awesome stuff.

title: American Pickers
description:
S26 E12 — Junkyard Jamboree
In Alabama, Robbie and Jersey go hog wild for Edd's classic car collection and bad-to-the-bone boneyard; Mike has a once-in-a-lifetime brush with country music stardom as he combs through the belongings of Hank Williams Jr.

title: American Pickers
description:
S02 E08 — One Pony Town
Lifelong picker and yard-sale aficionado Lester is known by his neighbors as the spooky collector; the guys visit a hard-core Illinois collector who says he wants to downsize; the guys pay a return visit to their picking mamma, Judy.

title: American Pickers
description:
S08 E08 — Hometown Pickin'
The guys find themselves waist deep in Kenny's ragtag collection; a man's stockpile is so large that he keeps it in an old school; a pair of muskets that could be centuries old; the guys pick in Mike's hometown.

title: American Pickers
description:
S07 E08 — Duke of Oil
Mike falls for a one-of-a-kind vintage motorcycle sign; a man keeps his treasures in a creepy cabin in the woods; Danielle's unique company car drives her crazy.

title: American Pickers
description:
S03 E03 — What's in the Box?
A New York collector has filled a train station with vintage cars; the guys stop at a New Hampshire home with an interesting weathervane on the roof; auctioneer Paul's property is packed with treasures his father rescued from the trash.

title: American Pickers
description:
S07 E04 — Guys and Dollhouses
A vintage theater marquee; rare opera house relics; Mike gets into a heated negotiation over a Victorian doll house.

title: American Pickers
description:
S03 E12 — Frank's Big Shot
The guys stumble upon a salvage yard that's been in a family for generations; Mike eyes a brass diving helmet; Frank zeros in on a hood ornament; a Wild West picking opportunity.

title: American Pickers: Best Of
description:
S08 E07 — Born to Ride
Do you yearn for the freedom of the open road? Well, get ready to feel the wind blowing through your hair as Mike and Frank cruise the country looking for anything and everything motorcycle.

title: American Pickers
description:

Mike and Frank have their hands full with a high-strung collector; Danielle lands in New York City for a high-stakes auction of rock 'n' roll memorabilia.

title: American Pickers
description:
S19 E05 — Ready to Race
The guys are excited to go and visit a former racer and adrenaline junkie in his vintage garage in Ohio.

title: American Pickers
description:

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E04 — The Lost Colony of Roanoke
In 1587, a group of settlers land off the coast of North Carolina on Roanoke Island to establish the first English Colony in America; a few years later, the 115 men, women and children vanish without a trace, leaving only cryptic clues.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E06 — The Death and Fortune of Pablo Escobar
Pablo Escobar, the narco-trafficker who single-handedly supplied most of America's cocaine in the 1980s, had billions of dollars in cash; by the time he was gunned down in 1993, it's believed he was worth over $50 billion in today's money.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E15 — The Killing of Bugsy Siegel
Notorious mobster Bugsy Siegel is gunned down in his Beverly Hills living room; Siegel's killing becomes front page news; no arrest is ever made.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S04 E16 — Unlocking the Secrets of Stonehenge
It's one of the most famous prehistoric monuments on Earth -- a mysterious arrangement of stones that have adorned the English countryside for millennia; nobody knows how the landmark was built or why.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S02 E01 — Expedition Bermuda Triangle
A search into the extreme depths of the Bermuda Triangle, where five American torpedo bombers and the search plane dispatched to find them disappear without a trace in December 1945.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E01 — Roswell
A 200-yard swath of debris landed near Roswell, New Mexico; some believe it was an alien craft, others that it was a secret government experiment.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E01 — Montezuma's Lost Treasure
An Aztec king's glittering treasure vanishes into thin air, inspiring a 500-year search that spans continents; one of the greatest warriors of all-time amassed a vast horde believed to be worth more than $3 billion today.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E05 — The Final Flight of Amelia Earhart
Amelia Earhart, the world's most famous female pilot, takes off on the final leg of a record-breaking flight; but Earhart never arrives at her next stop: an island in the Pacific Ocean; the search for this flier has revealed conflicting stories.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S05 E15 — Salem Witch Trials
A notorious tragedy leads to one of the darkest chapters in early American history; in 1692, fear rips through the small town of Salem, Massachusetts; accusations fly, and many people are put to death.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S03 E12 — The Chicago Tylenol Murders
A series of unexplained deaths near Chicago in 1982 starts a nationwide panic; the victims are connected by one frightening detail: cyanide-tainted capsules of Extra-Strength Tylenol; 40 years later, it remains an active FBI investigation.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E10 — The Search for Atlantis
It's history's most famous lost city; the island kingdom that's baffled explorers for centuries; some say Atlantis is a myth, while others insist it was a very real place wiped out thousands of years ago.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E08 — Who Is the Boston Strangler
A series of shocking murders shake the city of Boston to its core.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E13 — The Missing Tesla Papers
Nicola Tesla had revolutionary ideas, but in the hands of the wrong people, those ideas could be used for evil purposes; when Tesla died, he allegedly had 80 trunks of papers full of ideas, but only 60 have been seen again.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S06 E16 — Percy Fawcett and the Lost City of Z
Percy Fawcett becomes obsessed with a lost city deep in the Amazon jungle, a place he names the City of Z; Fawcett vanishes trying to locate it despite numerous missions to find him.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries

The search for the illusive Northwest Passage leads to a historic expedition that sets sail into a labyrinth of ice and is never heard from again.
